s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia
key_facts: 50-year-old man
Known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray–white
Near–complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor is in close contact with peripheral nerves, with positive S100 and negative pan-cytokeratin, EMA, and other epithelial markers

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and multiple cutaneous neurofibromas, with a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation in the superficial bladder wall

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells are positive for S100 and negative for epithelial markers, with a spindle cell proliferation and a collagenous matrix

shortlist.label: Neurofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and a malignant spindle cell tumor with prominent cytological atypia and frequent mitoses

shortlist.label: Malignant triton tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and a malignant tumor with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation, although this is less likely given the immunohistochemical profile
